description: RAPID: Multi-Hazard Damage to Puerto Rico’s Infrastructure - Investigation of the Interaction of Hurricane and Earthquakes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Arash Zaghi, University of Connecticut (uconn.edu). This project aims to identify the compounding impacts of 2017 Hurricane Maria and the 2020 Earthquake series. Traditionally, post-disaster damage assessment activities focus on one hazard and overlook the potentially destructive cascading effects of multiple hazards on structures and infrastructure. This project provides data resulting from field reconnaissance emphasizing multi-hazard effects and interactions. Coverage: Ponce, PR. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Multihazard damages, RAPID Facility, Puerto Rico, Hurricane Maria, earthquakes, infrastructure. Published 2022-06-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
